description: FP4-Local checkpoint served by the exact eugr b12x ARM64 image pinned in vcruz305’s kit at 0d727c4e. Eight concurrent sequences, a 262,144-token window, FP8 KV and four-token MTP speculation. Preserves the kit’s b12x load format and one-worker compilation setting. The kit’s disk-backed PLE table (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=disk with B12X_DISK_BACKEND=io_uring) cannot run in our sandbox (io_uring is blocked; direct GDS needs a real nvidia-fs), so the table is held in host-shared RAM (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=shared, as the passing local-nvidia dual does); that moves it into the vLLM budget, so GPU-memory utilization is the admission maximum 0.89 (kit 0.8) with a peak of 124,290,276,025 bytes. No hardware evidence yet; a measured peak replaces it.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next FP4-Local vLLM single Spark (vcruz305)
